title: Glowing sailing boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='hull' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9a3c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d94f1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sailMain' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6d8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd24a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sailJib' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb545'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sea' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#35c3d9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1152a8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sea -->
  <rect x='0' y='74' width='100' height='26' fill='url(#sea)'/>
  <path d='M0 78 Q10 74 20 78 T40 78 T60 78 T80 78 T100 78 L100 84 Q90 80 80 84 T60 84 T40 84 T20 84 T0 84 Z' fill='#7fe8f5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M0 90 Q12 86 24 90 T48 90 T72 90 T96 90 L100 90 L100 94 Q86 90 72 94 T48 94 T24 94 T0 94 Z' fill='#a9f4ff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='16' width='3' height='58' rx='1.5' fill='#c97a2b'/>
  <rect x='48' y='16' width='1' height='58' fill='#f5c07a'/>

  <!-- main sail -->
  <path d='M51 20 L80 62 L51 62 Z' fill='url(#sailMain)'/>
  <path d='M51 20 L64 41 L51 41 Z' fill='#fffbe9' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M51 22 L76 60 L51 60 Z' fill='none' stroke='#fffbe9' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- jib sail -->
  <path d='M45 22 L22 62 L45 62 Z' fill='url(#sailJib)'/>
  <path d='M45 24 L27 60 L45 60 Z' fill='none' stroke='#fff3cf' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- hull -->
  <path d='M18 66 L82 66 L74 80 L26 80 Z' fill='url(#hull)'/>
  <path d='M18 66 L82 66 L80 69 L20 69 Z' fill='#ffc27a'/>
  <rect x='30' y='71' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe6b8'/>
  <rect x='46' y='71' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe6b8'/>
  <rect x='62' y='71' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe6b8'/>

  <!-- pennant -->
  <path d='M48 16 L58 18 L48 21 Z' fill='#ff5470'/>

  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='34' r='1.6' fill='#fff7c4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='28' r='2' fill='#fff7c4'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='46' r='1.4' fill='#fff7c4'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='50' r='1.4' fill='#fff7c4'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='12' r='1.3' fill='#fff7c4'/>
  <path d='M78 14 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 Z' fill='#ffe86b'/>
</svg>
